reason: V1 independently shuffled estimator-specific row arrays, making its preregistered common-holdout minimum impossible (observed overlap 756 approximately equals 0.2 squared times N). V2 keys assignment only by raw catalog index and uses entirely fresh split and CR seeds.

common_model.holdout_assignment: SplitMix64(raw_catalog_index, split_seed); a shared raw row has exactly the same assignment under both estimators.

bgc.holdout_policy: Exclude every hash-held-out raw target row from the BGc median reference pool.
bgc.nearby_policy: Rows below 1500 km/s are reference-only and never enter the Gaussian BGc likelihood.

external_local_sheet_gate.role: Separately labelled observer-environment gate, not a peculiar-velocity calibration statistic.

policy.bgc_statistical_adoption: Both estimators and all numerical gates must pass. Cross-estimator log densities are not subtracted.
policy.N192_and_P2_authorization: Statistical adoption plus the external Local-Sheet gate authorize a fresh N192 BGc validation; only that N192 pass can authorize P2.
